summary: The video offers a field-guided exploration of composing multi-subject landscape scenes (flowers, waves, rainbow) and a detailed, hands-on post-processing flow in Photoshop. It emphasizes precise spacing between primary subjects, horizon alignment via warp tools, and a layered approach to color and light. The instructor demonstrates when focus-stacking is impractical in the field, how to isolate and enhance a rainbow, and how to sculpt light and atmosphere through Dodge/Burn, color grading, and masking techniques, all while discussing practical trade-offs and time-management on location in New Zealand.
